@graph.description: Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) is a root extract studied mainly for persistent stress, stress-related anxiety, and sleep rather than immediate relief. Meta-analyses report a possible benefit, but trials use different extracts and doses and the certainty is limited; product standardization and thyroid, liver, pregnancy, and sedative cautions matter.
